data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for ASP.NET SignalR client
data.what_it_does: Provides a client to connect to an ASP.NET SignalR hub, subscribe to hub methods, and invoke server methods using string arguments and results.
use_when: Need real‑time communication with an ASP.NET SignalR server
Only string data is required for messages and method arguments
Running on Android or iOS with native SignalR support
avoid_when: Requiring advanced transport customization beyond the plugin
strengths: Simple API with connect, invokeMethod, and callbacks
Supports both Android and iOS, including cleartext traffic and ProGuard rules
Generic invokeMethod allows any number of string arguments
weaknesses: Only string arguments and return values supported
data.setup_notes: Add <application android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"> for HTTP URLs and keep class microsoft.aspnet.signalr.client.hubs.** { *; } in proguard-rules.pro for release builds
data.minimal_example:
SignalR signalR = SignalR(
  '<Your server url here>',
  "<Your hub name here>",
  hubMethods: ["<Your Hub Method Names>"]
  statusChangeCallback: (status) => print(status),
  hubCallback: (methodName, message) => print('MethodName = $methodName, Message = $message'));
signalR.connect();
